# WeatherPets

> WeatherPets (Weather Pets) is an iOS weather app that turns your real pet into your personal weather reporter — AI-generated weather scenes featuring your pet, accurate hourly and 10-day forecasts via Apple WeatherKit, severe weather alerts, morning and evening pet weather reports, and home screen widgets. Built by Relative Industries, LLC.

Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/weatherpets-weather-widgets/id6759507221

## Main pages

- [Home](https://myweatherpets.com/): What WeatherPets is and how it works
- [FAQ](https://myweatherpets.com/faq.html): Common questions about the app
- [Blog](https://myweatherpets.com/blog/): Pet weather guides, safety articles, gear reviews, and app comparisons
- [Meet the News Team](https://myweatherpets.com/pet-weather-team.html): The animated pixel pet reporters
- [Support](https://myweatherpets.com/support.html): Contact the WeatherPets team
